question:
Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for:

A person who insists on strict adherence to rules
solution: The correct answer is: **Martinet**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Martinet"** refers to a person who demands strict adherence to rules and regulations, often with a disciplined and authoritarian approach. (कठोर अनुशासनप्रिय व्यक्ति) • **Example: **The new manager was a martinet, ensuring that everyone followed the office rules to the letter. • **"Maverick"** refers to someone who is independent-minded and does not conform to the accepted norms or rules. (अधीन न रहने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example: **The scientist was a maverick, challenging conventional theories with his innovative ideas. • Hence, we can conclude that a person who insists on strict adherence to rules is best described by the term **"Martinet."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Martinet**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Maverick **(अधीन न रहने वाला व्यक्ति): An unorthodox or independent-minded person. • **Example:** Steve Jobs was considered a maverick in the tech industry due to his innovative ideas. • **Iconoclast **(परंपराओं को तोड़ने वाला व्यक्ति): A person who attacks or criticizes cherished beliefs or institutions. • **Example:** The artist was labeled an iconoclast for challenging traditional art forms. • **Bohemian** (स्वच्छंद जीवन जीने वाला व्यक्ति): A socially unconventional person, especially one involved in the arts. • **Example:** The poet lived a bohemian lifestyle, traveling from city to city and creating art. 47:T99b, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
